text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through hunting down old tomes with 
Azuma-san, it felt as though 
my understanding of the shared history 
between horsegirls and humans had 
deepened.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the recent joint study session for 
faculty and trainers, 
I was able to contribute to discussions 
using insights gained from Azuma-san, 
earning a newfound respect from Chairwoman 
Akikawa.
choice_data_list:
(I should find a way to thank Azuma-san 
next time.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, where I took Azuma-san 
was the coast of a certain fishing 
village.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
This place... I recall that a ritual 
is to be conducted here today.
choice_data_list:
Yes, I thought you might know of it, 
Azuma-san.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Offerings reaped from the sea are borne 
upon a boat-shaped portable shrine, 
carried by horsegirls as they sprint up 
the mountain...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Delivering the shrine to the sanctuary 
upon the summit, 
they present the offerings to the divine, 
praying for bountiful harvests, safe 
voyages, and abundant catches.
choice_data_list:
I thought you might enjoy a festival like 
this, Azuma-san.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. 
It is truly a sacred devotion.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
To witness it with my own eyes like this 
brings profound joy.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Carrying Portable Shrine
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Soon, bearing the heartfelt prayers of the 
townsfolk, 
the horsegirls lifted the shrine—and 
dashed up the mountain.

text_block_list.name: Fishing Village Priest
text_block_list.text:
Before the august presence of the great 
deities, with utmost awe and reverence, 
I humbly speak—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at the shrine alongside 
Azuma-san, 
the sacred sake and sea harvest had been 
presented before the altar, 
and the recitation of the norito ritual 
prayer had begun.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Humans and horsegirls—those who make their 
lives upon this land 
unite their hearts, offering prayers to 
the divine. 
...Truly, a radiant sight.

text_block_list.name: Fishing Village Priest
text_block_list.text:
Grant bountiful harvests upon the land, 
grant abundant blessing from the seas, 
watch over and protect the paths of 
voyaging vessels—

text_block_list.name: Fishing Village Priest
text_block_list.text:
That all may flourish for generations 
without end, 
with utmost awe and reverence, I humbly 
pray.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Soon the prayer recitation drew to a 
close, 
and together we watched the villagers 
present their sacred boughs 
and bow in solemn devotion before the 
altar.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Ah... 
It has come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I bear witness to sacred rites... 
I lose all track of passing time.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it was a truly priceless sight. 
Allow me to thank you 
for bringing me to this land.
choice_data_list:
Don't mention it, I didn't really do 
anything special myself.

Don't mention it, I didn't really do 
anything special myself.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Nay. This precious moment was granted 
only through your thoughtful 
consideration.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
You devoted yourself through this entire 
day 
simply to bring me joy.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
It was none other than you 
who made this fleeting time so profoundly 
sacred.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: Truly, you have my deepest gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Softly and tenderly, she enveloped my 
hand. 
Along with a cool, pristine touch, 
a refreshing draft brushed against my 
cheek.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. 
Forgive me...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Pray excuse my thoughtlessness. 
My hand was terribly cold, was it not?
choice_data_list: No, not at all...! More importantly—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Traveling to so many places together, 
I had come to know Azuma-san bit by bit. 
My feelings of warmth and closeness had 
only grown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Azuma-san felt the same way, 
and took my hand as a result—
choice_data_list: I'm honored, and it really makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
The "arcade," 
the streets bustling with youth, 
and today's sacred ritual—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
You and I 
have indeed shared many moments together.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Unconsciously. 
Far more than I had realized.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
I... cannot exist 
in the same manner as you.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Should I draw too close to the singular, 
I shall lose sight of the whole.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
I am the maiden of the Shuntaisai, 
one who watches over the shared path of 
horsegirl and man—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Therefore. 
This cannot be.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
It is time... to bring an end 
to this fleeting dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After parting ways with Azuma-san at the 
site—I returned to my room 
and took up my diary, which had recently 
become a daily habit.
choice_data_list:
"Today, I went to see a festival with 
Azuma-san."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had come to understand another part of 
Azuma-san— 
I hoped from the bottom of my heart that 
we could keep visiting various places 
together 
and continue growing closer like this.
